SCN-002: Invalid credentials are refused with 401

error.headline: [REQ AC-2] invalid auth → 401

auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: Invalid credentials return 200 instead of 401
final.rationale: AC-2 requires 401 Unauthorized for bad credentials. The API answers 200 OK with {"reason":"Bad credentials"} (the body matches; the status does not). Partner systems keying on the status would treat a failed login as success. (Confirmed in run 05-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): POST /auth with a wrong password → 200 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-002.md)

SCN-007.1: A booking missing a required field is rejected with 400 (firstname)

error.headline: [REQ AC-6] missing firstname → 400

signals: Server error (5xx) on a declared endpoint where the requirement specifies a different outcome.
auto.next: Replay the request (api-probe.ts) to confirm it reproduces, then record with --set.

final.title: A booking missing a required field causes 500 instead of 400
final.rationale: AC-6 / booking-rules.csv R1 R2 R4 R5: a missing required field must be rejected with 400, never 5xx. Every missing-field variant returns 500 Internal Server Error, so input validation is absent and the server fails on client input. (Confirmed in run 05-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): POST /booking without lastname → 500 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-007-missing-lastname.md)

SCN-008.2: Price and date boundaries are enforced (totalprice -1 → rejected)

error.headline: [REQ AC-6] totalprice -1 rejected with 400

signals: Also failed: [REQ AC-6] totalprice -1 not stored — expected [Array []], received [2990]
auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: A negative totalprice is accepted
final.rationale: booking-rules.csv R3: totalprice must be an integer ≥ 0 (0 is valid and passes). totalprice −1 is accepted with 200 and stored, where AC-6 requires 400 and not stored. (Confirmed in run 05-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): POST /booking with totalprice −1 → 200 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-008.2.md)

SCN-013: Cancelling a booking returns 204 and removes it

error.headline: [REQ AC-10] DELETE → 204

auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: Cancelling a booking returns 201 Created instead of 204 No Content
final.rationale: AC-10 requires 204 No Content for an authenticated DELETE. The cancellation works (a GET afterwards returns 404, which passes), but the API answers 201 Created, a status that means a resource was created. This finding was hidden in run 02 behind a test auth-plumbing defect and surfaced after the repair. (Confirmed in run 05-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): DELETE with the declared Authorization header → 201; GET afterwards → 404 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-013-correct-header.md, SCN-013-get-after-delete.md)

entries.title: SCN-014.1: Writing to a booking that does not exist returns 404 (PUT)

records.label: booking id that no longer exists

error.headline: [REQ AC-11] PUT unknown id → 404

auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: Writes to a booking id that does not exist return 405 instead of 404
final.rationale: AC-11: PUT, PATCH or DELETE of a non-existent booking must answer 404. The API answers 405 Method Not Allowed, which wrongly tells partners the method is unsupported rather than that the booking is gone. (Confirmed in run 05-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): authenticated PUT to a deleted booking id → 405 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-014-put-unknown.md)
